function.name: read_sap_object
function.description: Fetch the source code of an existing SAP object (program, class, method, function module). Use it to view or analyze code, and always as a prerequisite before modify_sap_object or review_sap_code.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to read

object_name.description: Technical name, e.g. 'ZCL_TEST', 'ZCL_TEST=>METHOD_NAME', 'Z_PROGRAM'. Supports a wildcard pattern to list matching objects (e.g. 'ZCL_AITOOL_*') and a comma-separated list to read several objects in one call (e.g. 'ZCL_A, ZCL_B, ZCL_C')
